description: This file defines the FunctionDefinition class, which models a lightweight representation of a TypeScript function or class method. It includes properties such as name, parameters, return type, access modifier, static and async flags, body, and signature information.

classes.name: FunctionDefinition
classes.description: Represents a lightweight model of a TypeScript function or class method with properties covering its signature and characteristics.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides Object.ToString() to generate a string representation of the function/method signature and body.
